verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM has an API (an 'API Access & Keys' docs page and an /api/ping endpoint), but nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec on the docs site all returned 404, and no llms.txt exists. The axis applies to a self-hostable platform with an API, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.
